en.headline: Man charged over alleged false statement to competition watchdog
en.dek: The Competition Commission said the Eastern Magistrates case is the first criminal prosecution for giving it false or misleading information.
body: A person has been charged with giving false or misleading information to the Competition Commission, in what the commission said on Friday was the first criminal prosecution of its kind.

The commission said the person had been required to attend a hearing and answer questions during an investigation into suspected anti-competitive conduct over maintenance works at an industrial building in Tuen Mun. Further inquiries indicated that, during the meeting, the person allegedly provided false or misleading information knowingly or recklessly. The case was passed to police for a criminal investigation.

The person was charged with one count of providing false or misleading information to the commission. The case was brought before Eastern Magistrates' Court on Friday. The commission did not name the defendant in its statement.

The commission said anyone asked to produce documents, attend a hearing or otherwise cooperate with an investigation must do so lawfully, and that failure to comply with its powers is a criminal offence.

zh.headline: 男子被控向競委會提供虛假或誤導資料
zh.dek: 競委會稱，案件周五在東區裁判法院提堂，是首宗因向該會提供虛假或具誤導性資料而提出的刑事檢控。
body: 競爭事務委員會周五表示，一名人士被控向競委會提供虛假或具誤導性的資料。競委會稱，這是首宗同類刑事檢控。
競委會說，早前調查屯門一幢工業大廈維修工程的懷疑反競爭行為時，根據《競爭條例》要求該人士出席聆訊並回答問題。進一步調查後，競委會認為他涉嫌在會面期間，明知或罔顧實情下提供虛假或具誤導性資料，其後把個案轉交警方作刑事調查。
該人士被控一項向競委會提供虛假或具誤導性資料罪，案件周五在東區裁判法院提堂。競委會的聲明沒有點名被告。
競委會重申，任何人被要求交出文件、出席聆訊或以其他方式配合調查，都須依法配合；不遵從競委會的調查權力屬刑事罪行。
